channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Granum to host 4-day virtual series on preparing landscape teams for spring
item.description: The event, hosted by Sam Gembel and Brian Fullerton, is a free live webinar series running from March 3-6.

item.title: NCLC set for milestone competition at Michigan State this March
item.description: This year's event marks a 50-year celebration that will bring together 800 of the nation’s horticulture and landscape students from approximately 60 schools.

item.title: Envu set to host mosquito add-on services webinar Thursday
item.description: The free virtual event will cover mosquito service trends and mosquito biology.

item.title: FNGLA accepting nominations for 2026 Industry Awards
item.description: Award recipients will be selected by a committee of industry peers and recognized during FNGLA’s Annual Convention, which will take place June 25-27.

item.title: Syngenta names Santiago, Catterson to new manager roles
item.description: Frank Santiago is now a district sales manager for Syngenta Professional Solutions, while Lorabeth Catterson assumes a territory manager role for the West district.

item.title: Strauss debuts Doonan High Safety Toe Work Boot, new E.S.T:AKTIK collection
item.description: E.S.T:AKTIK features cargo pants, bib overalls, work shirts and performance tees, while the Doonan High Safety Toe Work Boot uses the Boa Fit System.

item.title: Heritage Landscape Supply Group acquires Outdoor Solutions
item.description: Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Lincoln, Outdoor Solutions is owned and operated by brothers John & Bob Hendricks and currently employs 13 people.

item.title: Cetane Associate adds Kelsey Balque as executive assistant
item.description: Balque brings more than a decade of experience supporting leadership teams.

item.title: Bobyard, Horizon Distributors partner on Irrigation Takeoff product
item.description: The product provides automated area, turf and linear footage measurements alongside irrigation counts.

item.title: OTR Engineered Solutions updates online Track Finder tool
item.description: The changes include a new interface, more product selection and expanded information.
